text:
Neither goalie gave in for 65 minutes, and the shootout took 11 shooters to break. Zachary Bolduc finally beat Daniil Tarasov with a snap shot in the sixth round, after the first ten attempts were all saved. Nate Danielson then failed to answer for DET, and MTL won 1-0. The shootout goal was the only one of the night.

The game itself was a coin flip. Expected goals finished at 3.60 for MTL and 3.57 for DET, and each side deserved to win 50 percent of the time. J
